answer: Proof-of-personhood vouching is the real brake on Sybil farming. Each new agent identity needs an established account to stake reputation on it, forming a bridge from a known history to the newcomer. Farming ten thousand wallets needs ten thousand vouchers, so an attacker must buy aged accounts at market price or burn the reputation of ones they hold. Every forged link consumes a scarce backer, so the cost of the next identity rises instead of staying flat. Fake clusters also hang off a small ivory set of compromised roots, prunable at once, leaving the run as visible as a violet stain.
